description: This file contains the implementation of the TransactionAgent class, which manages distributed transactions including start, resolve, commit, and abort operations, with detailed logging and error handling.

classes.name: TransactionAgent
classes.description: Internal class implementing ITransactionAgent for managing distributed transactions with logging, synchronization, and error handling.

methods.name: StartTransaction
methods.description: Begins a new transaction, throwing an exception if the system is overloaded.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Resolves a given transaction by committing or aborting based on participants and involved resources.

methods.name: CommitReadOnlyTransaction
methods.description: Commits a read-only transaction, aborting if failures occur.

methods.name: CommitReadWriteTransaction
methods.description: Processes a read-write transaction, coordinating prepare and commit phases with the transaction manager and participants.

methods.name: Abort
methods.description: Aborts an ongoing transaction by notifying all participants.

methods.name: CollateParticipants
methods.description: Organizes participants into writers, resources, and identifies the manager.
